--- PART 1/5 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "The parent slot 11 scored highest 259.855. Need improve." / "Parent slot 11 at round 100 if opponent just cooperated and n=100? It checks n==100 before high coop? Actually if last == 'C', then if n==100 return D. Yes. So good."
STRATEGY: Parent is a forgiving TFT-like policy: cooperate by default, retaliate once when opponent defects, defect against always-defect, and defect on the final round if opponent just cooperated. The trace simulates the parent against the listed population slots (especially slot 0 and TFT-like opponents) and considers adding an early probe to exploit unconditional cooperators. It proposes modifying the parent by probing against perfectly cooperative opponents and exploiting them if they do not retaliate.

The trace simulates parent against slot0, slot4, slot2, and TFT-like opponents, and proposes adding an early probe that defects when the opponent has never defected, then falls back to parent logic once the opponent defects.
